newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to change stock index composition.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to change stock index composition.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it was changing the composition of the 30-share index to include stocks with higher capitalisation as well as a broader range of industries.
Half of the new index will comprise of stocks with the highest market capitalisation across 15 industries.
The other 15 stocks will be the most heavily capitalised ones, the bourse said in a statement.
Stocks that are already part of the 15 representing industries will not be included in this.
The bourse said the new index will come into effect on Wednesday but it did not name the stocks to be included.
It said the new index would account for 72 percent of total market capitalization as opposed to the present index which only reflects 57 percent of the market capitalization.
The last time the index was changed was in October, 1994.
